meta.name: atlas-report
meta.description: Render agent findings as a styled HTML report in the browser. Use when asked for "full report", "detailed report", "show in browser", or when CLI output exceeds the 40-line budget.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 agent 结果渲染为美观的浏览器报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 agent 输出的文本太长，想换一种更美观的方式查看
copy.tagline_en: Render agent findings as a styled HTML report in the browser
copy.fit_line_en: For you if agent output is too long and you want a formatted view

howto.what: 装好后，当你要一份完整报告或输出内容太多时，Claude会把分析结果整理成带有样式和交互功能的HTML网页，自动在浏览器打开，并在终端显示简要摘要。
howto.when: 当你要求“full report”、“detailed report”、“show in browser”等关键词，或者CLI输出超过40行时触发。

say.note: 生成带交互的HTML报告并打开。

say.text: 把刚才的分析结果输出为完整报告。
在浏览器展示分析结果。
say.note: 生成报告并在浏览器打开。

howto.what_en: When you ask for a full report or the CLI output exceeds 40 lines, the agent structures findings into a self-contained HTML report with dark/light themes, collapsible sections, and severity badges, then opens it in the browser and prints a CLI summary.
howto.when_en: Triggered by user requests containing 'full report', 'detailed report', 'show in browser', or when CLI output exceeds 40 lines.

say_en.note: Generates an interactive HTML report and opens it.

say_en.text: Format the latest analysis as a full report.
say_en.note: Structures findings into an HTML report.

say_en.text: Show the results in the browser.
say_en.note: Generates report and opens in default browser.
